    GROUP BY c.pad_id,c.campana_id,c.parcela_id
), ventanas AS (
    SELECT c.*,LEAD(c.fecha_ini_campana) OVER
        (PARTITION BY c.pad_id,c.parcela_id ORDER BY c.fecha_ini_campana,c.campana_id) AS fecha_ini_campana_siguiente
    FROM campanas c
